008package paint.generatesquares.calc;
009
010import paint.shared.objects.Square;
011
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013import java.util.Collections;
014import java.util.Comparator;
015import java.util.List;
016import java.util.stream.Collectors;
017
018/**
019 * Provides utility methods for analyzing square-based track data in the Paint experiment
020 * workflow. Supports background estimation, density calculations, and extraction of tracks
021 * from selected squares.
022 * <p>
023 * Includes static methods for:
024 * </p>
025 * <ul>
026 *   <li>Computing density values</li>
027 *   <li>Estimating background densities using iterative filtering</li>
028 *   <li>Extracting tracks from squares flagged as selected</li>
029 *   <li>Counting selected squares</li>
030 * </ul>
031 * <p>
032 * Also defines an inner class for returning background estimation results.
033 * </p>
034 * <ul>
035 *   <li>calculateDensity — compute density from counts, area, time, concentration</li>
036 *   <li>calculateBackgroundDensity — iterative background estimation</li>
037 *   <li>getTracksFromSelectedSquares — extract tracks from selected squares</li>
038 *   <li>getNumberOfSelectedSquares — count selected squares in a recording</li>
039 * </ul>
040 */
041public class SquareUtils {
042
043    /**
044     * Private constructor to prevent instantiation.
045     */
046    private SquareUtils() {
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * Estimates the background density from a list of squares. This is done
051     * by iteratively excluding squares whose track counts exceed a dynamically
052     * computed threshold:
053     * <p>
054     *      threshold = mean + 2 * standardDeviation
055     * <p>
056     * The mean is recalculated each iteration until:
057     *   • It stabilizes (relative change &lt; EPSILON), or
058     *   • A maximum number of iterations is reached.
059     *
060     * @param squares List of squares containing track counts; must not be null or empty.
061     * @return BackgroundEstimationResult containing the estimated mean and the squares
062     *         considered part of the background.
063     */
064    public static BackgroundEstimationResult calculateBackgroundDensity(List<Square> squares) {
065        if (squares == null || squares.isEmpty()) {
066            return new BackgroundEstimationResult(Double.NaN, Collections.emptyList());
067        }
068
069        double mean = squares.stream()
070                             .mapToDouble(Square::getNumberOfTracks)
071                             .average()
072                             .orElse(Double.NaN);
073
074        if (Double.isNaN(mean) || mean == 0) {
075            return new BackgroundEstimationResult(mean, Collections.emptyList());
076        }
077
078        final double EPSILON  = 0.01;
079        final int    MAX_ITER = 10;
080
081        double prevMean;
082        List<Square> current = new ArrayList<>(squares);
083
084        for (int iter = 0; iter < MAX_ITER; iter++) {
085            prevMean = mean;
086            final double meanForLambda = mean;
087
088            double std = Math.sqrt(
089                    current.stream()
090                           .mapToDouble(square -> Math.pow(square.getNumberOfTracks() - meanForLambda, 2))
091                           .average()
092                           .orElse(0)
093            );
094
095            final double threshold = meanForLambda + 2 * std;
096
097            List<Square> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
098            for (Square square : current) {
099                if (square.getNumberOfTracks() <= threshold) {
100                    filtered.add(square);
101                }
102            }
103
104            if (filtered.isEmpty()) {
105                break;
106            }
107
108            mean = filtered.stream()
109                           .mapToDouble(Square::getNumberOfTracks)
110                           .average()
111                           .orElse(mean);
112
113            current = filtered;
114
115            // Stop when convergence is reached
116            if (Math.abs(mean - prevMean) / prevMean < EPSILON) {
117                break;
118            }
119        }
120
121        return new BackgroundEstimationResult(mean, current);
122    }
123
124    /**
125     * Holds the results of a background estimation: the mean background track count
126     * and the list of squares that were categorized as background.
127     */
128    public static class BackgroundEstimationResult {
129
130        private final double       numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare;
131        private final List<Square> backgroundSquares;
132        private final int          numberOfBackgroundSquares;
133
134        /**
135         * Constructs an immutable result object.
136         *
137         * @param numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare    estimated background track mean
138         * @param backgroundSquares squares identified as belonging to the background
139         */
140        public BackgroundEstimationResult(double numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare, List<Square> backgroundSquares) {
141            this.numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare = numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare;
142            this.backgroundSquares                = backgroundSquares;
143            this.numberOfBackgroundSquares        = backgroundSquares.size();
144        }
145
146        /** @return mean background track count */
147        public double getNumberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare() {
148            return numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare;
149        }
150
151        /** @return list of background squares */
152        public List<Square> getBackgroundSquares() {
153            return backgroundSquares;
154        }
155
156        /** @return the number of background squares */
157        public int getNumberOfBackgroundSquares() {
158            return numberOfBackgroundSquares;
159        }
160    }
161
162    /**
163     * Computes the average number of tracks among the smallest non-zero track counts
164     * in the recording. The number of squares to average over is configurable.
165     *
166     * @param squaresOfRecording      list of squares (must not be null)
167     * @param nrOfAverageCountSquares number of smallest non-zero values to average
168     * @return average of selected small non-zero track counts, or 0.0 if none found
169     */
170    public static double calcAverageTrackCountInBackgroundSquares(
171            List<Square> squaresOfRecording,
172            int          nrOfAverageCountSquares
173    ) {
174
175        List<Integer> trackCounts =
176                squaresOfRecording.stream()
177                                  .map(Square::getNumberOfTracks)
178                                  .sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder())
179                                  .collect(Collectors.toList());
180
181        double total = 0.0;
182        int    n     = 0;
183
184        // Walk backwards (smallest values first)
185        for (int i = trackCounts.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
186            int value = trackCounts.get(i);
187            if (value > 0) {
188                total += value;
189                n++;
190                if (n >= nrOfAverageCountSquares) {
191                    break;
192                }
193            }
194        }
195
196        return n == 0 ? 0.0 : total / n;
197    }
198}
